blocks.content: Compose's healthcheck block is the YAML equivalent of the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK instruction, and it is the piece that makes depends_on's service_healthy condition actually work.
1. Defining a Health Check in Compose
blocks.text: 1. Defining a Health Check in Compose

blocks.content: A service's healthcheck block defines the same kind of real functional test covered in the Dockerfile module's HEALTHCHECK topic, a command that succeeds or fails, run on an interval, to determine whether the service is genuinely working, not just alive.

blocks.alt: The same real health test, expressed in Compose YAML

blocks.content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

code.content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

codes.yaml:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

blocks.content: A defined healthcheck is precisely what makes another service's depends_on: condition: service_healthy meaningful, without a healthcheck defined, there is no health status for that condition to actually wait on.

blocks.alt: A defined healthcheck is what makes service_healthy possible

blocks.content: docker compose ps shows each service's current health status right alongside its running state, a quick way to confirm whether a dependency genuinely finished initializing, not just that its container is up.

blocks.alt: Health status visible directly, per service

blocks.content:
docker compose ps
# NAME     STATUS
# db       Up 2 minutes (healthy)
# app      Up 1 minute

code.content:
docker compose ps
# NAME     STATUS
# db       Up 2 minutes (healthy)
# app      Up 1 minute

codes.bash:
docker compose ps
# NAME     STATUS
# db       Up 2 minutes (healthy)
# app      Up 1 minute

blocks.title: Key Takeaway
points: Compose's healthcheck block is the same real functional test as the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK instruction, just declared per service in YAML.
It is a prerequisite for depends_on's service_healthy condition, and its status is visible directly in docker compose ps.
